title: Muryoyin da Suka Yi Ibada a Kusa da Annabi
intro: A wata ƙasa mai nisa, wani manzo mai daraja ya fuskanci ƙiyayya mai tsanani daga masu mulki na wannan zamanin. Duk da haka, ƙaramin da'irar rayuka masu aminci sun tsaya kusa da wannan bawan Allah, suna sha'awar amsa kiran Allah. Imaninsu mara misaltuwa zai raba al'umma mai ƙarfi kuma a ƙarshe zai yi nasara a kan sojojin kafirci.
clues: Mu ƙaramin rukuni ne mai sadaukarwa, waɗanda suka haɗa kai cikin bangaskiya da manufa.
Mun tsaya kusa da wani manzo mai daraja wanda manyan hukumomin ƙasarsu suka ƙi shi.
Lokacin da wannan manzon ya tambaya, 'Su waye magoya bayana a tafarkin Allah?' muka amsa ba tare da wata shakka ba.
Mun roƙi wannan manzon ya nemi liyafa daga sama domin ya kawo mana kwanciyar hankali.
A cikin mutanen wancan zamanin, wasu sun yi imani ta hanyar sakonmu, wasu kuma sun ƙi, amma Allah ya ƙarfafa muminai.
Mu ne Hawwariyar - almajiran Isa masu sadaukarwa, waɗanda aka yi nasara ta hanyar taimakon Allah.

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوٓا۟ أَنصَارَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ لِلْحَوَارِيِّـۧنَ مَنْ أَنصَارِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَـَٔامَنَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَكَفَرَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ ۖ فَأَيَّدْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ عَلَىٰ عَدُوِّهِمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ ظَـٰهِرِينَ
verse: O you who have believed, be supporters of Allāh, as when Jesus, the son of Mary, said to the disciples, "Who are my supporters for Allāh?" The disciples said, "We are supporters of Allāh." And a faction of the Children of Israel believed and a faction disbelieved. So We supported those who believed against their enemy, and they became dominant. (61:14)
